guides.title: Your camping checklist
guides.content: Pack shelter, water, lighting, warm layers, first aid and waste bags. Check the weather before leaving.

guides.title: Pitching a tent
guides.content: Choose level ground away from flood channels. Secure all guy lines and follow the manufacturer instructions.

guides.title: Camping responsibly near Kandy
guides.content: Obtain landowner permission, check local restrictions, avoid fires where prohibited and take all litter home.
